It provides detailed project files and guidance, enabling users to create their own unique input devices using common microcontrollers like Arduino Pro Micro or Raspberry Pi Pico.

✨ 𝗞𝗘𝗬 𝗙𝗘𝗔𝗧𝗨𝗥𝗘𝗦 ✨

✅ Webcam-based lip reading for silent text transcription

✅ Optional LLM cleanup for enhanced accuracy
✅ Personalized language model training using user dictation history
✅ Customizable push-to-talk key and hands-free modes
✅ GPU acceleration for lip reading and training on Apple Silicon and NVIDIA GPUs

Lipflow is a local application for Mac, Windows, and Linux that transcribes silent lip movements captured by a webcam into text, which is then pasted at the cursor. It offers optional LLM-based cleanup for improved accuracy and customizes its language model based on user dictation history and practice.
